versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Hard gates" section requiring strict review process before drafting user-facing findings.
- Specified that each reported issue must provide precise file location evidence and exemption reasoning.
- Updated the reporting protocol to mandate verification checks and review protocol completion before findings are submitted.
- Clarified workflow order with a pre-report checklist directly linked from the "Before Submitting Findings" section.
- No functional or behavioral changes outside documentation/process update.

- Added SKILL.md for detailed guidelines on reviewing shadcn/ui components.
- Includes quick reference tables for common issues and valid patterns.
- Provides a comprehensive review checklist covering CVA, asChild, accessibility, and data-slot best practices.
- Highlights context-sensitive rules and when to apply specific review criteria.
- Clarifies library conventions and when not to flag standard patterns.
- Includes specific review questions and reference loading guidance to improve code review accuracy.
